Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia's situation and any follow-up on the Megaspeed investigation. The AI revolution theme, as noted by the Fed chair, remains a key narrative.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is facing significant headwinds; managing risk here is paramount.
plays: Consider trimming CRWD if it shows weakness; it's up significantly but marked TRIM.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
